title: How much cloth is needed for a skirt and a kurti?
description: The cloth for a skirt, 2.7 metres, and for a kurti, 3.5 metres, are added by lining up the points and carrying. Keeko doubts the result and thinks the sum is 5.12.
teaching_notes: One idea: add like places from the right and carry ten of a place to the next. Watch for students who write twelve after the point.

source: Priya needs 2.7 m of cloth and Shylaja needs 3.5 m. How much
video_script.why: The child can read decimals and add fractions with tenths, and now adds two decimals directly.
video_script.substitution: Write the points in one line, add like places from the right, and carry ten of a place to the next.
video_script.anchor: Two lengths of cloth, 2.7 metres and 3.5 metres, drawn as strips, with a place table below.
video_script.payoff_line: Add like places, and carry ten of a place to the next

names.Jia: needs 2.7 metres of cloth for a skirt
names.Ziva: needs 3.5 metres of cloth for a kurti

maths_rules: tenths: 7 + 5 = 12 tenths = 1 unit + 2 tenths; write 2, carry 1
video_script.design: Two cloth strips sit above a place table. The carried one travels from the tenths column to the units column in one colour.

beats.on_screen: title card From your book; two cloth strips, 2.7 m and 3.5 m
narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book about adding decimals.
<bookmark mark='p'/>Jia needs two point seven metres of cloth for a skirt.
<bookmark mark='s'/>Ziva needs three point five metres for a kurti. How much cloth is needed in all?

beats.on_screen: the two strips stay on the board
narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: like places add together; ten of a place make one of the next place

marks.like: the place table lines up on the point
marks.ten: an arrow runs from the tenths column to the units column

narration: <bookmark mark='like'/>We add decimals place by place, with one point exactly above the other.
<bookmark mark='ten'/>Ten of a place make one of the next place to the left.

beats.on_screen: Given: 2.7 m and 3.5 m of cloth
narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, two point seven metres and three point five metres of cloth.

beats.on_screen: To find: the total cloth, 2.7 m + 3.5 m
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the total cloth needed.

beats.on_screen: 2.7 above 3.5, with the points in one line

marks.line: the two numbers stand in columns on the point

narration: <bookmark mark='line'/>Step one, write the numbers with one point exactly above the other. Two point seven sits above three point five.

beats.on_screen: tenths: 7 + 5 = 12 tenths = 1 unit and 2 tenths; write 2, carry 1

marks.t1: the tenths column is boxed and twelve tenths is written
marks.t2: the one moves up to the units column

narration: <bookmark mark='t1'/>Step two, add the tenths. Seven tenths and five tenths make twelve tenths.
<bookmark mark='t2'/>Twelve tenths is one unit and two tenths. Write two in the tenths place, and carry one to the units.

beats.on_screen: units: 2 + 3 + 1 carried = 6; the point stays between the 6 and the 2

marks.u1: the units column is boxed and the sum is written

narration: <bookmark mark='u1'/>Step three, add the units. Two plus three plus the carried one is six.
<bookmark mark='u2'/>The point stays between the six and the two.

marks.f2: six and two tenths is matched with the column sum

narration: <bookmark mark='f1'/>Step four, check with fractions. Two and seven tenths plus three and five tenths is five and twelve tenths.
<bookmark mark='f2'/>That is six and two tenths, the same number.

marks.val: the two strips join into one strip

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Add like places, and carry ten of a place to the next.
<bookmark mark='val'/>The cloth needed in all is six point two metres.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the place table
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: a speech bubble: 2.7 + 3.5 = 5.12; twelve tenths are more than one unit; the bubble is crossed out

marks.fix: twelve tenths is regrouped into one unit and two tenths

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the sum is five point one two, since seven and five make twelve.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>But twelve tenths is more than one unit, so a carry is needed.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>Twelve cannot sit in the tenths place.
